name: collector-hub-static-site
description: Static marketplace-style website with client-side interactions.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.audit: npm run audit:npm && npm run audit:retire
scripts.audit:retire: mkdir -p reports && retire --path . --ignore node_modules,reports,playwright-report,test-results --severity high --outputformat json --outputpath reports/retirejs-report.json
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run sonar:prepare && npm run audit
